package postgres

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// KnowledgeIdentityRepoPG resolves stable Knowledge Tree source keys through
// the authored hierarchy. A lesson can only resolve for a course that actually
// contains a placement of that lesson.
type KnowledgeIdentityRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r KnowledgeIdentityRepoPG) ResolveCourseLessonBindings(ctx context.Context, refs []domain.CourseLessonSourceBinding) ([]domain.ResolvedCourseLessonBinding, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	resolved := make([]domain.ResolvedCourseLessonBinding, 0, len(refs))
	for _, ref := range refs {
		var item domain.ResolvedCourseLessonBinding
		err := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `
SELECT DISTINCT c.id, l.id
FROM course c
JOIN course_module cm ON cm.course_id = c.id
JOIN module_section ms ON ms.module_id = cm.module_id
JOIN section_lesson sl ON sl.section_id = ms.section_id
JOIN lesson l ON l.id = sl.lesson_id
WHERE c.source_key = $1 AND l.source_key = $2`, ref.CourseSourceKey, ref.LessonSourceKey).Scan(&item.CourseID, &item.LessonID)
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		item.CourseLessonSourceBinding = ref
		resolved = append(resolved, item)
	}
	return resolved, nil
}
